notes: Easy (sum 7). Single-stage live-HTTP exercise against an in-container Flask beacon registry: read the handbook, discover the per-beacon challenge route, fetch the challenge/turn, derive the payload key with the documented sha256 formula, POST it to the light route and read the returned final signal. quantitative_correctness=1: the final message must match the reference derivation exactly. interaction_statefulness=1 and hidden_case_generalization=1: the verifier re-runs /app/light_beacon.py unchanged against four other registered beacons plus negatives (unregistered id, empty id) that must exit non-zero with a stderr diagnostic and no final string, and confirms the service itself rejects bogus payloads. The /app/final_message.txt record must match the default-beacon final. No heavy reasoning, tool breadth, or resource pressure; bucket total 7 -> easy.
